title: 4 BLACK & WHITE KITCHEN CANIST...
reason: Midwinter Stylecraft Tonga duos (maker not named in the title) with a matching-era plastic canister set, modest mid-century value.
findings: Photo 2 backstamp (enlarged crop, print partly worn) reads TONGA / Stylecraft Fashion tableware by Midwinter / Staffordshire England, so the maker and pattern are not in the title. Four duos: matt black Fashion-shape cups with white interiors on squarish saucers printed with black and white zebra-type stripes. Sale listings I found date Tonga to the 1960s and credit Jessie Tait (unverified), so the title's 1950s is not confirmed. Four graduated cream moulded plastic canisters with sloped black lids, aluminium trim and gold script letters C, T, R and a fourth that reads as F or 7 (probably coffee, tea, rice, flour). No maker mark seen on the canisters, so they are not shown to be Midwinter.
condition: Cups and saucers look clean with no chips or cracks visible (one cup shown upside down). Canisters show light marks and wear. Lids, liners and the other saucer bases not inspected.
rescore_note: Four clean Midwinter Stylecraft Tonga duos (common 1960s pattern, not shown to be a rare or full set) plus unmarked plastic canisters: a pleasant retro lot but each part is low value, so the upper part of the $30-80 band.
